messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The rule gate has already run. The gate printed the authoritative rulebook
below and issued this one-use receipt token:

GATE_TOKEN: gyqnmQ_-VcF1nCYhFHVcHQ

Your final JSON must include this exact top-level field:
"gate_token": "gyqnmQ_-VcF1nCYhFHVcHQ"

Here is the full character rulebook. It is authoritative:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",
    "dwarves",
    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

scenes.caption: Mara unrolls a map of the ruined city.
scenes.visual_description: A windswept hilltop overlooking shattered spires at dusk; an ink-stained coated figure pins down a curling parchment with a brass compass.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp warns of every wrong turn.
scenes.visual_description: Close-up of an oil lamp with a single glowing eye inside its flame, hovering above the map, casting a long amber shadow.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox is wound up for scouting.
scenes.visual_description: Small clockwork fox with blue glass eyes, key-wind tail mid-turn, perched on a broken milestone marker.

scenes.caption: The Glass Diver steps out of a roadside puddle mirror.
scenes.visual_description: A figure in a clear diving helmet emerges from a rain puddle, coat reflecting fractured city lights and crumbling towers.

scenes.caption: They approach the cracked castle gates.
scenes.visual_description: Massive iron-bound gates split down the middle, vines crawling through; the four travelers cast small silhouettes against the looming stone.

scenes.caption: Tattered royal banners flutter in the dead square.
scenes.visual_description: A plaza of shattered fountains, faded crimson banners hanging from broken poles; Tin Fox sniffs at a torn sigil on the ground.

scenes.caption: A frightened townsperson points toward the cursed tower.
scenes.visual_description: The sleeping tax collector slumps against a doorway, ledger pillow under his head, mumbling and gesturing limply at a leaning black spire.

scenes.caption: The lamp hisses that the tower is a trap.
scenes.visual_description: The oracle lamp's flame-eye narrows toward a tower wreathed in violet smoke; Mara hesitates with compass raised.

scenes.caption: Distant roars hint at something winged.
scenes.visual_description: Shadow of vast leathery wings sweeps across a rooftop; Tin Fox flattens its ears, blue eyes wide, on a tiled gable.

scenes.caption: An armored patrol marches the cobbled lane.
scenes.visual_description: From an alley shadow, the team watches plated boots and lantern poles pass; the Glass Diver's helmet catches a sliver of torchlight.

scenes.caption: The Glass Diver slips through a stained-glass window.
scenes.visual_description: A figure dives headfirst into a tall cathedral window, body rippling through the colored panes like water without breaking them.

scenes.caption: Inside, a magic door pulses with runes.
scenes.visual_description: An archway carved with shifting silver glyphs in a moonlit hall; the oracle lamp floats close, illuminating the runes one by one.

scenes.caption: Mara decodes the rune sequence from her maps.
scenes.visual_description: Mara crouched on marble tiles, parchments fanned around her, brass compass spinning wildly, Tin Fox holding down a corner with its paw.

scenes.caption: The sleeping tax collector blocks the inner door.
scenes.visual_description: A round official snoring across a threshold, stamped papers stuck to his sleeves, the team trying to gently roll him aside.

scenes.caption: They find the captive behind a mirrored wall.
scenes.visual_description: The Glass Diver reaches a gloved hand through a tall mirror; the reflection shows the sleeping tax collector slumped in a gilded cell — the actual hostage.

scenes.caption: Alarms ring as the patrols close in.
scenes.visual_description: Red lanterns flare along corridor windows; Tin Fox sprints ahead, sparks flying from its wind-key, leading the others down a spiral stair.

scenes.caption: They race across the cracked river bridge.
scenes.visual_description: A long stone bridge over a black river at dawn; the four flee while masonry crumbles behind them, the oracle lamp swinging at Mara's belt.

scenes.caption: Safe on the far bank, Mara folds her map.
scenes.visual_description: Sunrise over reedy marsh; Mara tucking parchment into her coat, Tin Fox perched on her shoulder, the Glass Diver gazing back at the smoking skyline, the lamp dimmed to a sleepy ember beside the still-snoring official.
